glebis-claude-cognitive-toolkit-root.description: Guided CBT and DBT practice exercises — a 7-step thought record and DBT opposite action — with configurable Socratic pushback and optional health context. Triggers on "/cbt", "/dbt", "/thought-record", "/record", "/opposite", "/opposite-action", "I need to work through something", "help me with a thought", "cognitive distortion", "I'm spiraling", "can we do a thought record".
